text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
The day after the disturbance at the ruins,
{0} was guided by Nephy Nella to the
plaza by the Demon's Foot Citadel.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──遺跡での騒動の翌日。
{0}はネフィ＝ネラの案内を受けて、
鬼岩城塞の広場へと足を運んでいた。

text_block_list.name: Merchant 1
text_block_list.text:
Carry it in carefully! If the thorns on its
scales get stuck in you, it's going to be a
painful day to remove them!
text_block_list.orig_text:
気を付けて運び込めー！
そいつの鱗のトゲ、
刺さったら中々抜けないぞ！

text_block_list.name: Merchant 2
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't shove it! That meat's as tough as
steel when it's raw! If you drop it and it
lands on someone's foot, it'll be a disaster!
text_block_list.orig_text:
コラ、
押すな！
この肉は生だと鋼鉄並みの強度があるんだから、
落として足にでもぶつけたら
大変なことになるんだぞ！

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text:
So much has been brought in, it's getting
lively~ It's a parade of ingredients from
ferocious monsters you rarely even see in Gio
Gehenna~
text_block_list.orig_text:
たくさん運ばれて、
賑わってきましたね～
ジオ・ゲヘナでもお目にかかれない
凶悪な魔物を由来とした
食材のオンパレードですよ～

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Planning to merely sightsee? Come now, I
would say this is a prime chance for you to
get some training in.
text_block_list.orig_text:
物見遊山のつもりかえ？
そぉれ、
腕力を鍛える好機であろう？

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! You want me to help them bring that
thing in?! ...I wonder if there are any
ingredients left that aren't as dangerous...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うっ！
あれ運び込むの
手伝ってこい
ってことですか～っ！？
……なるべく危険じゃない食材、
残ってないかな……

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
My dear Lord Knight, please relax. The
cooking shall commence as soon as the
preparations are complete.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士殿や、
どうぞごゆるりとお寛ぎを。
場の支度が調い次第、
煮炊きに取り掛かりまする故。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. Those monsters were specially
gathered for the purpose of entertaining you,
Lord Knight... I would not hesitate to call
them the supreme delicacies Gio Gehenna
prides itself upon.
text_block_list.orig_text:
然様。
彼の魔物共は、
騎士殿への饗応の為に取り揃えし逸品……
ジオ・ゲヘナが誇る
至高の美食と称して
憚りありませぬ。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
I shall spare no effort in preparing them. If
you would look forward to the heartfelt
hospitality I shall prepare with my own
hands... I would be most pleased--
text_block_list.orig_text:
腕縒りかけて
拵えまする故に。
わっちの手に為る心尽くしの持て成し、
御期待頂けますと
是幸い──

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Hm...! Just now... what did you say?
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ……
今、
なんと？

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: L-LORD KNIGHT-SAN?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
き、
騎士殿さん～っ？

text_block_list.name: Merchant 1
text_block_list.text:
Are you serious, boy?! Y-You're saying you've
really got the resolve for that!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
本気かよ、
坊主！？
お前さんにその覚悟が
あるっていうのか！？

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
...Your words, Lord Knight, are a joy beyond
all expectation. In that case... I shall
gratefully accept your kindness.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……騎士殿の御言葉、
望外の慶びに他ならず。
然れば……
御厚意に縋らせていただきとう存じまする。

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text:
No, no, don't agree so easily! Lord
Knight-san, do you understand?! Cooking
together with the Princess while using those
ingredients means that you will--... HMPH?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやいや、
そんな易々と！
騎士殿さん、
分かっているんですか～！？
この食材で媛さまと一緒に料理をするということは……
むぐっ！？

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
...Dear Mia. Naturally, you will all be
helping as well, correct?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ミーアや。
無論のこと、
汝らも手伝うてくれるのであろ？

text_block_list.name: ミーア
text_block_list.text:
むぐっ……
ぷはぁ～！！
媛さま、
ひどいですよ～！
急に口をふさぐとか～──
text_block_list.orig_text:
むぐっ……
ぷはぁ～！！
媛さま、
ひどいですよ～！
急に口をふさぐとか～──

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... A-All right, I won't say anything
unnecessary...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うひっ……
わ、
分かりました、
余計なことは言いませんってば～……

text_block_list.name: Merchant 1
text_block_list.text:
...Looks like we've got no choice but to
rally behind them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……どうやら
俺たちも覚悟を決めるしかないようだな。

text_block_list.name: Merchant 2
text_block_list.text:
This is the person Lady Nephy Nella has
acknowledged. I have no objections.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ネフィ＝ネラさまがお認めになった相手だ。
異論はねぇよ。

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text:
However~! Cooking these ingredients is
dangerous and difficult~! It's as if they
symbolize the harsh land of Gio Gehenna~! No
one has ever tried to take on this
challenge~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ですが～！　
これら食材の調理は
危険かつ困難！
まるで過酷なジオ・ゲヘナの大地を象徴するが如くです～！
未だかつて
挑もうとした者は一人もいません！

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text:
If the Princess and Lord Knight-san wish to
take on this journey, we'll support them as
citizens of Gio Gehenna! ...Isn't that right,
everyone?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それでも
媛さまと騎士殿さんが成し遂げようというなら、
私たちもジオ・ゲヘナの民として、
微力ながらお支えします～！
……いいですよね、
みなさん！？

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: UOOOHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: うおおおおおおおおっ！！！！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You all understand my heart. Splendid
indeed.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──フフ。
皆者、
我が心知り也。
重畳也。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
I too shall strive not to disgrace your
resolve, Lord Knight. Now then, let us begin
cooking together.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わっちも騎士殿の御覚悟に恥じぬよう
励みまする故、
何卒宜しく、
共々に
煮炊きに取り掛かりましょうぞ。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
This here is the "Rib Meat of the
Rock-Rending Great Serpent". It is as solid
as stone, and severing it requires the swing
of a master. Approach it with clumsy
technique, and your arm bones will be the
ones that shatter.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──此れなるは、
『巌裂大蛇ノ肋肉』。
岩石の如く堅牢にして、
断裁には熟練の士の一振りを要しまする。
粗忽な刀技で臨めば、
腕骨砕くるが道理。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Lord Knight, lend me your aid... I shall turn
my hand into a blade and cut through it. I
ask that you lend me your strength.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士殿や、
お手を拝借……
わっちの手を刃に変じて
断ち切りまする故。
御力添えを賜りたく存じまする。

text_block_list.name: Merchant 1
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Thanks to their collaboration, the meat
was cut in half with a single slash!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おおっ、
お二人の共同作業で
肉が一刀両断に！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Next in line shall be the broth. The
"Flame-Devouring Heroic Fish", caught from
the Shouka Waterfall... Bring it to a boil
with raging flames, and simmer it in the pot
until its flavor seeps out.
text_block_list.orig_text:
然らば次は、
出汁を。
『硝火水瀑布』より釣り上げたる
『焔喰ノ益荒魚』……
業火を以て沸き立たせ、
旨味の滲み出るまで
釜にて煮込む也。

text_block_list.name: Merchant 2
text_block_list.text: Hot?! T-This heat is way too intense...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
熱い！？
か、
火力が高すぎる……！

text_block_list.name: Merchant 3
text_block_list.text:
*cough*... Th-This steam...!? Boy, don't
breathe it in! If you do, you'll probably be
bedridden for three days and nights!
text_block_list.orig_text:
げほ
ごほッ……
こ、
この湯気は……！？
坊主、
吸うんじゃないぞ！
吸ったらたぶん、
三日三晩は寝込むことになる！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
While the broth boils, prepare the herbs. The
Tenro Grass, gathered from the Kotei
Plains... Wash it thoroughly, and chop it to
a size suitable for plating.
text_block_list.orig_text:
出汁の煮える間に、
草片の支度を。
『蠱啼原』にて摘み取りたる
『甜露草』……
念入りに洗い清め、
盛りつけに適う大きさに刻み候。

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: Lord Knight-san, watch out~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士殿さん、
危ないです～！

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text:
Owowowow!? These wild herbs sometimes have
bugs with sharp teeth on them... Ouch! Ouch!!
There's no point in biting me, I don't taste
good!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──いたたたた！？
この野草、
歯の鋭い虫がついてることがあって～……
いたい
いたい！！
私なんか噛んでも
おいしくないですよ～！！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Mia, come here. I shall cleanse it for you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミーアや、
此方に来なんし。
掃き清めてくれようぞ。

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: AGH!?
text_block_list.orig_text: あぶっ！？

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you very much, my Princess~...
Though some of that hit my actual body
too~...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ありがとうございます、
媛さま～……
ちょっと私本体にも当たりましたけど～……

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text:
Still, Lord Knight-san, you look like you're
having fun... Even though the cooking is this
dangerous...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにしても騎士殿さん、
楽しそうですね～……
こんなに危険な調理なのに～……

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text:
W-What kind of experience do you have...?
Don't tell me our support wasn't even
necessary...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ど、
どういう経験をお持ちなんですか～？
もしかして、
私たちのサポートとか
余計だったのでは……？

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Do not say such boorish things. In the
presence of a guest, we must show our
resolute spirit at hosts.
text_block_list.orig_text:
無粋なことを申すで無し。
御客人の面前なれば、
持て成す家人の意気を示すべき也。

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text:
I can't really argue when you put it like
that~...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう言われると
弱いんですけどね～……

text_block_list.name: Merchant 1
text_block_list.text:
S-Someone! Help me! This monster's bodily
fluids are... GYAAAAAH!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だ、
誰かっ！　
助けてくれ！
魔物の体液が……
ぎゃー！！！

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, I'll be right there~! ...We'll
handle things over here, so please keep
helping the Princess, Lord Knight-san!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はいはい、
今行きます～！
……こちらは私たちでなんとかしますので、
騎士殿さんは引き続き
媛さまのお手伝いを
お願いしますね～！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh. Such things do indeed happen...♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
……フフ。
然様な事は決して──
在りまする……♪

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Truly, a most fitting sight. To cook while
standing shoulder to shoulder with my
people... such moments are rare indeed. A joy
that fills my heart to the point it feels as
though I might ascend to the heavens.
text_block_list.orig_text:
誠正鵠、
むべなるかな。
諸人と肩並べ
煮炊きに勤しむ……
斯様な折は、
然う然う在りませなんだ。
天にも昇るかの如く、
実に愉しき心地でありますれば。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Then... we are finally at the final stage.
With you and I working hand in hand, while
receiving their support, we shall surely
succeed, Lord Knight♪...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……然らば、
いよいよ大詰めで候。
わっちと騎士殿が手を取り合い、
加えて彼奴等の下支えあらば、
必ずや
遂げられましょうぞ……♪

text_block_list.name: Merchant 1
text_block_list.text: ...It's... complete...

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: We did it... We really did it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
やりました……
私たち、
やり遂げましたよ～……

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, your support was most commendable.
And Lord Knight, your courage and skill in
the kitchen were truly splendid.
text_block_list.orig_text:
皆々の支え、
大儀で在った。
騎士殿の胆力、
調理の腕も、
誠に御見事でありんした。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
And thus... a masterpiece that makes full use
of the bounty of this land of Purgatory: the
"Purgatory Kiln-Stewed Monster Hotpot".
text_block_list.orig_text:
而して。
煉獄の地の産物を
余さず活かした逸品──
『煉獄窯煮の魔物鍋』の
完成に御座いまする。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us partake before it grows
cold. Lord Knight, come over here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
扨て、
冷めぬうちに頂きましょうぞ。
騎士殿、
此方にお越しくだしゃんせ。

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text:
A-AT LAST! This moment has finally
arrived~...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
つ、
ついに！
この時がきたんですね～……！

text_block_list.name: Merchant 1
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! All our hard work's about to pay off!
Take good care of us from now on... "Lord
Husband"!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ！　
俺たちの頑張りも報われるってもんだ！
これからよろしくな──
婿殿！！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
For this formal meal, there exists a special
custom... one passed down since ancient times
among the great clans and noble houses of Gio
Gehenna.
text_block_list.orig_text:
此度の本膳には、
ジオ・ゲヘナの豪族、
権門の間にて
往古より伝えられし
特別なる作法がありまして喃。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
It is a method of cooking that cannot be
accomplished alone, the preparation of
ingredients so difficult they demand the
utmost skill. By supporting one another and
overcoming it together, the act becomes proof
of an eternal bond. In other words... this is
what is known as a "Wedding Rite".
text_block_list.orig_text:
其は独力では叶わぬ調理法──
至難極める扱い難き食材の拵えを、
相支え合い、
共に乗り切り、
永遠の盟約の証と致す。
此れ即ち……
『婚礼の儀』に御座いまする。

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh~... Judging by that blank look on your
face, you really didn't know about it, did
you~
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～……
そのキョトンとしたお顔、
やっぱり知らなかったんですね～

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text:
BUT~...! There's no turning back now~! This
wedding rite is completed when you feed each
other the dish you made... so steel yourself,
Lord Knight-san~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ですが、
もう後戻りはできませんよ～！
この婚礼の儀は、
作った料理をお互いに食べさせ合うことで
完遂する……
覚悟を決めてください、
騎士殿さん～！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Then, if I may be so bold... allow me to be
the first to bring a bite to your lips, Lord
Knight.
text_block_list.orig_text:
然らば、
僭越ながら……
先ずはわっちより
騎士殿の御口元へ
お運び申しましょうぞ。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Now then, Lord Knight. Say "Ahhh"♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあさ、
騎士殿や。
『あ～ん』……♪

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: ─Ufufu
text_block_list.orig_text: ──コロコロコロ。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
'Twas but a jest. But seeing that bashful
expression of yours up close... ah, what
incomparable bliss it is♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
戯れにありんす。
騎士殿の恥じらう御顔──
いと愛らしく、
間近で眺めるは
無上の至福でありんすなぁ♪

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
text_block_list.orig_text: えっ……？

text_block_list.name: Merchant 2
text_block_list.text: A "jest"...?
text_block_list.orig_text: 戯れ……？

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Lord Knight, you are a man worthy of being
called a "World-saving Hero". And the maidens
who admire you are surely as countless as the
stars in the heavens. Given that, to bind you
in marriage here through a ceremony sprung
upon you unawares...
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士殿は、
万邦を救いし英傑と称するに相応しき御方。
而して
騎士殿を慕う女子らも、
天の星が如く御座すは
疑うべくも無し。
況してや、
予め儀礼の仔細を報せず、
騙し討ちの如き婚姻を結ぶ等。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
If I were to claim you as mine here and
welcome you as my groom, conflict among our
worlds, if not even my own lands, would be
inevitable... Truly, you are a man who causes
sin merely by existing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
此の場でわっちが騎士殿を我が物とし、
婿君として召し迎えんとするならば、
諸国の軋轢は必至……
あにはからんや、
文字通りの
罪作りな御方でありんすなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text:
I-In other words... it'd turn into an
international incident...? J-Just hearing
that makes my stomach hurt...
text_block_list.orig_text:
つ、
つまり～……
国際問題に発展しちゃう
ってことでしょうか～？
き、
聞いただけで胃の痛くなる言葉ぁ～……

text_block_list.name: Merchant 3
text_block_list.text:
Then... what about our resolve? Was putting
our bodies on the line to help just a waste
of time...
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ……
俺たちの覚悟は？
体を張ってお支えした意味って……

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
It was hardly wasted effort. For you, it
should have served as fine training, should
it not?
text_block_list.orig_text:
只の徒労には非ず。
汝らにすれば、
良き錬磨の機となったであろう？

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, you lot... We are about to hold a
banquet with our guest, compose yourselves at
least a little.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やれ、
汝らと云うものは。
此れより客人との饗宴だというに、
些かなりは
襟を正しなんし。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
...However, Lord Knight. What I said just now
was not entirely in jest.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なれど、
騎士殿。
先の話、
其の全てが戯言ではありんせん。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
If that is truly your wish... Then even if it
were to spark conflict across worlds, I would
gladly become your wife and stand beside you
for the rest of our days. Should your heart
ever settle upon that choice... call upon me
anytime♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
若し
騎士殿が御望みとあらば──
仮令諸国と軋轢を生もうとも
連れ合いとして
御台所と成り、
終生添い遂げるも吝かでなし。
御心の定まりし時は、
何時なりと
御声掛けくだしゃんせ……♪

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Despite all the chaos, {0} enjoyed
the Gio Gehenna cuisine he had prepared
together with Nephy Nella and the others, and
the pleasant night gradually wore on.
text_block_list.orig_text:
てんやわんやはありつつも、
{0}は
ネフィ＝ネラたちと作ったジオ・ゲヘナの料理を堪能し、
楽しい夜は更けていくのだった。
